paragraphs.s: VOCABULARY: ATTITUDE AND OPINION ADJECTIVES

parts: ATTITUDE AND OPINION ADJECTIVES —— 态度和观点的形容词

paragraphs.s: ① We often use these adjectives to describe attitude and opinion. Use one of them to say how each of the people in 1–8 feels.

ana.frame: 主谓宾 + 祈使句：We often use these adjectives to describe attitude and opinion.
parts: to describe attitude and opinion —— 来描述态度和观点
Use one of them to say how each of the people in 1–8 feels —— 用其中一个说说 1–8 里每个人的感受

paragraphs.s: A ashamed
paragraphs.tr: A 羞愧的。

ana.frame: 词框：ashamed（羞愧的）
parts: ashamed —— 感到羞愧的，感到羞耻的
gram: be ashamed of 对……感到羞愧
ana.tip: 做了错事、感到抱歉时用。

paragraphs.s: B cheerful
paragraphs.tr: B 高兴的。

ana.frame: 词框：cheerful（高兴的）
parts: cheerful —— 高兴的，兴高采烈的
ana.tip: 心情好、兴高采烈时用。

paragraphs.s: C confident
paragraphs.tr: C 自信的。

ana.frame: 词框：confident（自信的）
gram: be confident of/about 对……有信心
ana.tip: 对结果有把握时用。

paragraphs.s: D grateful
paragraphs.tr: D 感激的。

ana.frame: 词框：grateful（感激的）
gram: be grateful to sb for sth 因某事感激某人
ana.tip: 别人帮了你、想道谢时用。

paragraphs.s: E jealous
paragraphs.tr: E 嫉妒的。

ana.frame: 词框：jealous（嫉妒的）
ana.tip: 觉得别人有自己没有、不公平的时候用。

paragraphs.s: F impressed
paragraphs.tr: F 印象深刻的。

ana.frame: 词框：impressed（印象深刻的）
parts: impressed —— 印象深刻的，钦佩的
gram: be impressed by/with 对……印象深刻
ana.tip: 别人做得好、你赞叹时用。

paragraphs.s: G patient
paragraphs.tr: G 有耐心的。

ana.frame: 词框：patient（有耐心的）
gram: be patient with 对……有耐心
ana.tip: 愿意慢慢等、不急躁时用。

paragraphs.s: H upset
paragraphs.tr: H 沮丧的。

ana.frame: 词框：upset（沮丧的）
parts: upset —— 沮丧的，失落的，心烦的
ana.tip: 事情不如意、心里难过时用。

paragraphs.s: Thanks very much for helping me.
paragraphs.tr: 非常感谢你帮我。

ana.frame: 省略句：Thanks very much for helping me.
ana.tip: 道谢 → 感受是 grateful（感激的）。官方答案：1 grateful。

paragraphs.s: You're very kind.
paragraphs.tr: 你真好心。

ana.frame: 主系表：You're very kind.
ana.tip: 夸对方好心 —— 和感激呼应。

paragraphs.s: I've been in a good mood all day!
paragraphs.tr: 我一整天心情都很好！

ana.frame: 主系表（现在完成时）：I've been in a good mood all day!
gram: in a good mood 心情好
ana.tip: 心情好 → cheerful（高兴的）。官方答案：2 cheerful。

paragraphs.s: I've studied really hard, so I'm sure I'll do well in tomorrow's test.
paragraphs.tr: 我学得很努力，所以我肯定明天考试会考好。

ana.frame: 并列句：I've studied really hard, so I'm sure I'll do well in tomorrow's test.
parts: I've studied really hard —— 我学得很努力
I'm sure I'll do well in tomorrow's test —— 我肯定考试会考好（主系表）
clauses: so 引导结果；be sure (that) 从句
gram: do well in 在……做得好
ana.tip: 「肯定能考好」→ confident（自信的）。官方答案：3 confident。

paragraphs.s: It was silly of me to do that.
paragraphs.tr: 我那样做真傻。

ana.frame: 主系表：It was silly of me to do that.
clauses: It is + adj + of sb + to do sth 句型
gram: be silly of sb to do sth 某人做某事很傻
ana.tip: 做了傻事、很抱歉 → ashamed（羞愧的）。官方答案：4 ashamed。

note.cn: 愚蠢的（It was silly of me to do that 我那样做很傻）

paragraphs.s: I'm very sorry.
paragraphs.tr: 我非常抱歉。

ana.frame: 主系表：I'm very sorry.
ana.tip: 道歉 —— 配合上一句的羞愧感。

paragraphs.s: I thought my team would win the cup, but they lost the final 5–0!
paragraphs.tr: 我以为我的队会赢得奖杯，但他们在决赛 0–5 输了！

ana.frame: 并列句：I thought my team would win the cup, but they lost the final 5–0!
parts: my team would win the cup —— 我的队会赢
but they lost the final 5–0 —— 但决赛 0–5 输了
clauses: 宾语从句 + 虚拟语气 would；but 表转折
gram: win the cup 赢得奖杯
ana.tip: 期望落空、心情低落 → upset（沮丧的）。官方答案：5 upset。

paragraphs.s: I can't believe that's the first time you skated!
paragraphs.tr: 我不敢相信那是你第一次滑冰！

ana.frame: 主谓宾：I can't believe that's the first time you skated!
parts: that's the first time you skated —— 那是你第一次滑冰
clauses: 宾语从句；the first time 引导时间从句
ana.tip: 对别人的表现惊叹 → impressed（印象深刻的）。官方答案：6 impressed。

paragraphs.s: You did so well!
paragraphs.tr: 你做得太好了！

ana.frame: 主谓：You did so well!
ana.tip: 赞叹对方 —— 印象深刻的另一个线索。

paragraphs.s: You can take as much time as you like.
paragraphs.tr: 你想花多长时间都行。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：You can take as much time as you like.
parts: as much time as you like —— 你想花多少时间就多少
clauses: as … as you like 你想多……就多……
ana.tip: 愿意等、不急 → patient（有耐心的）。官方答案：7 patient。

paragraphs.s: I'll wait here for you.
paragraphs.tr: 我在这里等你。

ana.frame: 主谓：I'll wait here for you.
gram: wait for sb 等待某人
ana.tip: 耐心等待 —— 答案 patient 的证据。

note.cn: 等待（wait for sb 等待某人）

paragraphs.s: It's not fair: that boy's got a much newer phone than me!
paragraphs.tr: 这不公平：那个男孩的手机比我的新多了！

ana.frame: 主系表 + 补充：It's not fair: that boy's got a much newer phone than me!
parts: that boy's got a much newer phone than me —— 那个男孩的手机比我的新得多
gram: much + 比较级 更……得多
ana.tip: 觉得别人有自己没有、不公平 → jealous（嫉妒的）。官方答案：8 jealous。

paragraphs.s: GRAMMAR: -ED AND -ING ATTITUDE AND OPINION ADJECTIVES
paragraphs.tr: 语法：-ed 和 -ing 形式的态度/观点形容词。

ana.frame: 小标题：GRAMMAR: -ED AND -ING ATTITUDE AND OPINION ADJECTIVES
parts: ATTITUDE AND OPINION ADJECTIVES —— 态度和观点的形容词
gram: -ed 形容人的感受；-ing 形容事物
ana.tip: 口诀：-ed 说「人觉得」，-ing 说「事令人」。

paragraphs.s: ② Choose the correct form of the adjectives.
paragraphs.tr: ② 选出形容词的正确形式。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Choose the correct form of the adjectives.
parts: the correct form of the adjectives —— 形容词的正确形式
ana.tip: 先看主语是「人」还是「事」，再选 -ed 或 -ing。

paragraphs.s: I was very interesting/interested in what that woman said about music.
paragraphs.tr: 我对那个女人说的关于音乐的话非常感兴趣。

ana.frame: 主系表：I was very interesting/interested in what that woman said about music.
parts: what that woman said about music —— 那个女人关于音乐说的话
gram: be interested in 对……感兴趣
ana.tip: 主语是「我」（人）→ 用 -ed：interested。官方答案：1 interested。

paragraphs.s: That was probably the most bored/boring TV show I've ever seen.
paragraphs.tr: 那可能是我看过的最无聊的电视节目。

ana.frame: 主系表：That was probably the most boring TV show I've ever seen.
parts: the most bored/boring TV show —— 最无聊的电视节目
clauses: 省略 that 的定语从句
gram: boring 令人无聊的（形容事物）
ana.tip: 节目是「事物」→ 用 -ing：boring。官方答案：2 boring。

note.cn: 无聊的（形容人）；boring 令人感到无聊的（形容事物）

paragraphs.s: I was disappointed/disappointing that my friends couldn't go to the fair with me.
paragraphs.tr: 朋友们不能和我一起去游乐会，我很失望。

ana.frame: 主系表：I was disappointed that my friends couldn't go to the fair with me.
parts: that my friends couldn't go to the fair with me —— 朋友们不能和我去游乐会
clauses: that 引导原因/宾语从句
ana.tip: 主语是「我」（人）→ disappointed。官方答案：3 disappointed。

note.cn: 失望的；disappointing 令人失望的

paragraphs.s: The ending of that film was really shocked/shocking.
paragraphs.tr: 那部电影的结尾真的很令人震惊。

ana.frame: 主系表：The ending of that film was really shocking.
parts: The ending of that film —— 那部电影的结尾
was really shocked/shocking —— 真的很令人震惊
gram: shocking 令人震惊的（形容事物）
ana.tip: 「结尾」是事物 → shocking。官方答案：4 shocking。

note.cn: 吃惊的，震惊的，愤慨的；shocking 令人震惊的

paragraphs.s: It kept me awake last night!
paragraphs.tr: 它让我昨晚一直睡不着！

ana.frame: 主谓宾补：It kept me awake last night!
clauses: keep sb + 形容词 使某人保持……
gram: keep sb awake 让某人睡不着
ana.tip: 结尾把人吓得睡不着 —— 印证 shocking 的强烈。

paragraphs.s: I felt exhausted/exhausting after running in such a long race.
paragraphs.tr: 在跑了那么长的比赛后，我感到筋疲力尽。

ana.frame: 主系表：I felt exhausted after running in such a long race.
parts: after running in such a long race —— 在跑了这么长的比赛之后
gram: exhausted 筋疲力尽的（形容人）
ana.tip: 主语是「我」（人）→ exhausted。官方答案：5 exhausted。

note.cn: 筋疲力尽的；exhausting 使人疲惫不堪的

paragraphs.s: I get annoyed/annoying with my little brother when he behaves like that.
paragraphs.tr: 我弟弟那样表现的时候，我会很恼火。

ana.frame: 主系表：I get annoyed with my little brother when he behaves like that.
parts: with my little brother —— 对我弟弟
when he behaves like that —— 当他那样表现时
gram: get annoyed with sb 对某人恼火
ana.tip: 主语是「我」（人）→ annoyed。官方答案：6 annoyed。

note.cn: 恼怒的，烦恼的；annoying 令人恼火的

paragraphs.s: Some of the awful things on the TV news make me feel a bit depressing/depressed.
paragraphs.tr: 电视新闻里的一些可怕的事让我有点沮丧。

ana.frame: 主谓宾补：Some of the awful things on the TV news make me feel a bit depressed.
parts: Some of the awful things on the TV news —— 电视新闻里的一些可怕的事
a bit depressing/depressed —— 感到有点沮丧
clauses: make sb do sth 使某人做某事
gram: depressed 沮丧的（形容人的感受）
ana.tip: 「我」的感受 → depressed（不是 depressing）。官方答案：7 depressed。

note.cn: 抑郁的，沮丧的；depressing 令人沮丧的

paragraphs.s: 'Stranger Things' is one of the most excited/exciting series on television.
paragraphs.tr: 《怪奇物语》是电视上最令人兴奋的剧集之一。

ana.frame: 主系表：'Stranger Things' is one of the most exciting series on television.
parts: the most excited/exciting series —— 最令人兴奋的剧集之一
clauses: one of the most + adj + 复数名词
gram: exciting 令人兴奋的（形容事物）
ana.tip: 剧集是事物 → exciting。官方答案：8 exciting。

note.cn: 兴奋的，激动的；exciting 令人兴奋的

paragraphs.s: B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with -ed and -ing adjectives.
paragraphs.tr: B1 Preliminary 的考生经常在 -ed 和 -ing 形容词上出错。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with -ed and -ing adjectives.
parts: B1 Preliminary candidates —— B1 Preliminary 的考生
with -ed and -ing adjectives —— 在 -ed 和 -ing 形容词上
gram: make mistakes with 在……上出错
ana.tip: 记住：-ed 说人的感受，-ing 说事物的性质。

paragraphs.s: ③ Some of these sentences are correct and some have mistakes. Correct the sentences that are wrong.
paragraphs.tr: ③ 这些句子里有些是对的，有些有错误。把错的句子改正过来。

ana.frame: 主系表 + 祈使句：Some of these sentences are correct and some have mistakes. Correct the sentences that are wrong.
parts: Some of these sentences are correct —— 有些句子是对的
and some have mistakes —— 有些有错误
Correct the sentences that are wrong —— 改正错的句子
ana.tip: 判断每句：形容「人」还是「事」？用的 -ed/-ing 对不对？

paragraphs.s: I felt very tiring after doing homework all evening.
paragraphs.tr: 做了一晚上作业后，我感到很累。

ana.frame: 主系表：I felt very tiring after doing homework all evening.
parts: felt very tiring —— 感到……（这里错了）
after doing homework all evening —— 做了一晚上作业之后
ana.tip: 有错：「我」感到累，应该用 tired（tiring 是「令人累的」）。官方答案：1 tiring → tired。

paragraphs.s: It was a very frightened book, but I read it all and I enjoyed it.
paragraphs.tr: 那是一本很吓人的书，但我把它读完了，还挺喜欢。

ana.frame: 并列句：It was a very frightened book, but I read it all and I enjoyed it.
parts: a very frightened book —— 一本很……的书（这里错了）
but I read it all and I enjoyed it —— 但我读完了还挺喜欢
ana.tip: 有错：书「令人害怕」→ frightening。官方答案：2 frightened → frightening。

paragraphs.s: Thomas explained the rules of the game, but we were still a bit confused.
paragraphs.tr: Thomas 解释了游戏规则，但我们还是有点困惑。

ana.frame: 并列句：Thomas explained the rules of the game, but we were still a bit confused.
parts: the rules of the game —— 游戏规则
but we were still a bit confused —— 但我们还是有点困惑
ana.tip: 这句是对的 ✓（我们「人」感到困惑用 -ed）。官方答案：3 correct。

paragraphs.s: After a week at school, I just want to stay at home and feel relaxing.
paragraphs.tr: 在学校待了一周后，我只想待在家里放松。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：I just want to stay at home and feel relaxing.
parts: After a week at school —— 在学校一周之后
want to stay at home and feel relaxing —— 想待在家、感到……（这里错了）
gram: relaxed 感到放松的（形容人）
ana.tip: 有错：「我」感到放松 → relaxed。官方答案：4 relaxing → relaxed。

paragraphs.s: There are some really excited rides at the summer fair.
paragraphs.tr: 夏季游乐会上有一些非常刺激的游乐设施。

ana.frame: 存在句：There are some really excited rides at the summer fair.
parts: some really excited rides —— 一些非常……的游乐设施（这里错了）
at the summer fair —— 在夏季游乐会上
gram: exciting 令人兴奋的（形容事物）
ana.tip: 有错：设施「令人兴奋」→ exciting。官方答案：5 excited → exciting。

paragraphs.s: I'm a bit worrying about my friend Lacey.
paragraphs.tr: 我有点担心我的朋友 Lacey。

ana.frame: 主系表：I'm a bit worrying about my friend Lacey.
parts: a bit worrying —— 有点……（这里错了）
about my friend Lacey —— 关于我朋友 Lacey
ana.tip: 有错：「我」担心 → worried。官方答案：6 worrying → worried。

paragraphs.s: She hasn't phoned.
paragraphs.tr: 她还没打电话来。

ana.frame: 主谓（现在完成时）：She hasn't phoned.
ana.tip: 还没消息 —— 所以担心。

paragraphs.s: Something really embarrassing happened to me yesterday.
paragraphs.tr: 昨天我身上发生了一件很尴尬的事。

ana.frame: 主谓：Something really embarrassing happened to me yesterday.
parts: Something really embarrassing —— 一件很尴尬的事
gram: embarrassing 令人尴尬的（形容事物）
ana.tip: 这句是对的 ✓（事情「令人尴尬」用 -ing）。官方答案：7 correct。

paragraphs.s: I was very surprising when I saw that famous singer in our street.
paragraphs.tr: 在街上看到那位著名歌手时，我非常惊讶。

ana.frame: 主系表：I was very surprising when I saw that famous singer in our street.
parts: was very surprising —— 非常……（这里错了）
when I saw that famous singer in our street —— 当我在街上看到那位著名歌手时
gram: surprised 感到惊讶的（形容人）
ana.tip: 有错：「我」感到惊讶 → surprised。官方答案：8 surprising → surprised。

paragraphs.s: FOCUS: IDENTIFYING KEYWORDS IN EXAM QUESTIONS
paragraphs.tr: 重点：找出考题里的关键词。

ana.frame: 小标题：FOCUS: IDENTIFYING KEYWORDS IN EXAM QUESTIONS
parts: KEYWORDS IN EXAM QUESTIONS —— 考题里的关键词
ana.tip: 先圈关键词，再带着问题去读文章。

paragraphs.s: ④ Look at these typical Part 3 questions and unfinished statements. Underline the key words in each.
paragraphs.tr: ④ 看这些典型的 Part 3 问题和未完成的句子。划出每一句的关键词。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Look at these typical Part 3 questions … Underline the key words in each.
parts: Look at these typical Part 3 questions and unfinished statements —— 看这些典型的 Part 3 问题和未完成句
Underline the key words in each —— 划出每一句的关键词
gram: unfinished statement 未完成的陈述
ana.tip: 官方划法：问题词（What/How/Why）+ 动词 + 关键名词。

paragraphs.s: What does the writer like most about playing the trumpet?
paragraphs.ul: like most about playing the trumpet
paragraphs.tr: 关于吹小号，作者最喜欢的是什么？

ana.frame: 疑问句：What does the writer like most about playing the trumpet?
parts: does the writer like most —— 作者最喜欢
about playing the trumpet —— 关于吹小号
clauses: like most about … 最喜欢……的地方
ana.tip: 划出 like most 和 playing the trumpet —— 答案一定是「最喜欢的那一点」。

paragraphs.s: The writer felt nervous when he answered the phone because …
paragraphs.ul: nervous when he answered the phone because
paragraphs.tr: 作者接电话时感到紧张，因为……

ana.frame: 主系表 + 从句：The writer felt nervous when he answered the phone because …
parts: when he answered the phone —— 当他接电话时
clauses: when 引导时间从句；because 引导原因
ana.tip: 划出 nervous、answered the phone、because —— 要找的是「紧张的原因」。

paragraphs.s: How did Emma feel about going to a new school?
paragraphs.ul: How did Emma feel about going to a new school
paragraphs.tr: Emma 对去新学校感觉如何？

ana.frame: 疑问句：How did Emma feel about going to a new school?
parts: about going to a new school —— 对去新学校
clauses: feel about sth 对……感觉如何
ana.tip: 划出 How、feel、new school —— 问的是「感受」。

paragraphs.s: Francesca was bored during the train journey because …
paragraphs.ul: bored during the train journey because
paragraphs.tr: Francesca 在火车旅途中觉得无聊，因为……

ana.frame: 主系表 + 从句：Francesca was bored during the train journey because …
